say:1:1231197001:1.text: No, these are the lifeboats for the large ships that go out to deep sea.
say:1:1231197001:1.source_cn: 不，我们在准备给出海大船准备的救生艇。

say:2:1231197002:1.text: Since the port opened back up, a lot of captains have put in orders for more lifeboats.
say:2:1231197002:1.source_cn: 自从码头解封后，很多大船船长都下达了增加救生艇的命令。

say:3:1231197003:1.text: Reports say that during run-ins with sea monsters, many large ships fell into chaos over a shortage of lifeboats.
say:3:1231197003:1.source_cn: 据说不少遭遇海怪的大船遇险时，因为救生艇数量不够引起了...

say:4:1231197004:1.text: Hopefully these boats will offer some peace of mind, and maybe even save some lives should it come down to it.
say:4:1231197004:1.source_cn: 希望这批救生艇配备后，海员不会再重蹈覆辙。
